claims.statement: In the specified 1,836-encoding labeled Prüfer sample of orders 8 through 16, there are 37 eligible parameter rows; all have p=x+2, select every original leaf, have S<0, and satisfy E<=(x+1)Q. No sampled eligible row has a proper favorable-leaf selector.
claims.scope: Only the seeded, shape-biased labeled Prüfer sample and exact arithmetic protocol in the source REPORT.md and EVIDENCE.json. This is bounded evidence and makes no universal claim about ordinary trees.
claims.reason: Disposition: retained. The copied source replay reproduces the sealed EVIDENCE.json byte-for-byte. An independent heap-based Prüfer regeneration and direct all-subset census confirms the 37 eligible rows and zero proper selectors across the full specified sample; separate direct subset enumeration verifies every eligible row, original leaf selector, exact summand and aggregate. All observed rows have S<0 and E<=(x+1)Q. The scope is expressly finite and does not prove or refute a universal assertion.

limitations: The Prüfer protocol samples labeled trees with replacement; isomorphic duplicates are retained, and it is not exhaustive at any searched order.
All 37 eligible rows have p=x+2 and select every original leaf, so the sample tests neither higher eligible ranks nor proper selectors.
Finite negative aggregates and positive CT_x gaps do not prove the universal aggregate or the CT_x compensation bound.
Independent arithmetic checks cover every row in the specified sample but do not establish a general theorem or a counterexample.
